name: Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from a configurable side of the screen. Uses Portal, Overlay, and FocusTrap. Matches Modal ARIA patterns with role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'. Transition respects prefers-reduced-motion.

notes: role='dialog' and aria-modal='true' match the ARIA dialog pattern.
Body scroll is locked while the drawer is open.
Focus is trapped inside via FocusTrap and restored to the trigger on close.
Transitions are disabled when prefers-reduced-motion: reduce is active.
CSS logical properties (inset-inline-start/end, inset-block-start/end) ensure correct RTL behaviour.

onClose.description: Called when the drawer should close.

position.description: Side from which the drawer slides in. Uses CSS logical properties for RTL support.

size.description: Inline-size (for start/end) or block-size (for top/bottom) of the drawer panel.

do: Use Drawer for navigation panels, filter sidebars, and detail views.
Include a visible close button inside the drawer.
Provide a concise aria-label when no visible heading is present.
dont: Do not open a Drawer from inside a Modal.
Do not rely on the Drawer for critical multi-step flows — use a Modal instead.
